description: Deactivate one of the user's fixed or editable codes so the short link and QR stop redirecting. The code and its scan history stay on the account and can be reactivated later in the app. This is not a permanent delete. Use this when the user wants a printed or shared code to stop working. Do not use this to change a destination (use update_dynamic_qr on an editable code) or to create a new code.

reactivate.description: Set true to turn the code back on if the plan allows it (default false)

reauthToken.description: Step-up reauth token from the app when unlock is required

unlock.description: Required true when reactivating a destination-locked editable code

name: deactivate_code
title: Deactivate a code
